专为工具套件打造的轻量级前端界面解决方案: A lightweight frontend UI solution built for tool suites
使用 CSS 变量作为按钮颜色: Use CSS variables as button colors
语义化按钮，支持 6 种变体、4 档尺寸、图标、加载态、纯图标与块级布局。点击: A semantic button with multiple variants, four sizes, icons, loading state, icon-only mode and full-width layout. Clicking the host dispatches the native click event.
文本输入框组件。内置 label、hint 说明文字、校验状态（success: A text input component with built-in label, hint text, validation states (success / danger / info), disabled state and a compact state model. It dispatches a native-style cgo-input event.
自包含 SVG 图标组件，数据来自共享图标注册表（95 个）。支持三种颜色模式：: A self-contained SVG icon component backed by the shared icon registry (95 icons). It supports three color modes: adaptive UI color (default), fixed color, and brand gradient.
旧版 tool-card、glass-card、info-card、danger: A component wrapper for the legacy tool-card, glass-card, info-card and danger-card styles.
菜单按钮：触发器 + 菜单两个插槽。互斥展开、点击外部关闭、点击菜单项后自动收起: A dropdown button with trigger and menu slots. Dropdowns open exclusively, close on outside click, and collapse after a menu item is selected.
管理一组选项卡面板，标签栏从每个 cgo-tab 的 label 自动生成。: Manages a set of tab panels and automatically builds the tab bar from each cgo-tab label.
自适应侧边导航组件。电脑端显示为纵向侧边栏导航（磨砂玻璃背景），移动端自动切换为: A responsive side navigation component. It renders as a vertical frosted-glass sidebar on desktop and automatically switches to horizontally scrollable pill tabs on mobile. Navigation items are defined with <cgo-nav-item> children.
遮罩 + 居中对话框，移动端自动转底部抽屉。支持点击遮罩 / Esc 关闭。: An overlay with a centered dialog that automatically becomes a bottom sheet on mobile. Supports closing via the overlay or Esc.
右上角紧凑气泡提示（与 Popup 通知同排共享队列，不进入通知中心）。通常不直: A compact top-right toast that shares a queue with popup notifications and does not enter the notification center. It is normally invoked with showToast() or window.CGO.showToast() rather than written as a tag.
来源于 CGoPush 的标准化通知与公告中心组件。包含单卡片 <cgo-not: Standardized notification and announcement-center components derived from CGoPush. Includes <cgo-notice-card>, the full <cgo-notice-center> panel, and floating <cgo-notice-popup> notifications. Supports four categories: software, operation, promotion and system.
包裹任意内容，悬停时在上方/下方显示气泡提示。: Wraps arbitrary content and shows a tooltip above or below on hover.
环形加载指示器与进度圆环组件。支持 Spinner 旋转加载与 Progress: A circular loading indicator and progress-ring component. Supports spinner rotation and progress fill/clear modes, three speed levels, clockwise/counter-clockwise direction, and timed automatic animation.
旧版表格容器组件。内部可放标准 table，推荐继续使用 modern-tabl: A legacy-compatible table container. Standard table elements can be placed inside; use the modern-table class to retain the legacy appearance.
圆形头像，支持图片或首字母占位（中文取末字、英文取首字母）。: A circular avatar supporting an image or initials fallback (last character for Chinese names, initials for English names).
对话气泡。role=user 右侧主色，role=bot 左侧浅色；可选 sen: A conversation bubble. role=user uses the primary color on the right; role=bot uses a light style on the left. Optional sender / time fields show the sender and timestamp.
带点阵背景预览区和底部操作栏的媒体查看器组件。: A media viewer with a dotted preview background and bottom action bar.
旧版浮动控制面板的组件化封装。支持拖拽、贴边自动磁吸对齐、折叠/最小化及关闭等丰: A componentized wrapper for the legacy floating control panel, with dragging, edge snapping, collapse/minimize and close interactions.
纯前端 SVG 计算题验证码。点击图片刷新；启用 zoom 后左侧显示放大按钮，: A client-side SVG arithmetic CAPTCHA. Click the image to refresh; with zoom enabled, a zoom button appears on the left and expanding/collapsing does not refresh the challenge.
点击切换明暗，长按 800ms 恢复跟随系统。自动同步到所有 iframe。: Click to toggle light/dark mode; long-press for 800 ms to return to system mode. The theme is automatically synchronized to all iframes.
管理端控制专用的下拉选择框，支持 4 种继承与权限状态机。: A dropdown selector for administration controls with four inheritance/permission states.
管理台偏好设置列表行，迁移自旧版 pref-item / pref-left-g: An administration preference row migrated from the legacy pref-item / pref-left-group / pref-actions styles.
北京地铁线路色的组件化入口。底层仍使用旧版 --line-color-X 变量，: The component entry point for Beijing metro line colors. It still uses the legacy --line-color-X variables and follows the optimized/official palette switch. Use the line attribute for a line pill, or copy var(--line-color-X) as a CSS value for buttons, cards and other elements.
用户组别卡片，使用旧版等级渐变变量和磨砂玻璃胶囊标签。四种渐变不是写死在文档里，: A user-tier card using the legacy tier gradient variables and frosted-glass pill labels. The four gradients are read from --level-default-gradient, --level-test-gradient, --level-prime-gradient and --level-admin-gradient rather than hard-coded in the docs.

一组 <cgo-tab>；每个 cgo-tab 内为该页内容: A set of <cgo-tab> elements; each contains the panel content

侧边栏底部操作区（移动端隐藏）: Action area at the bottom of the sidebar (hidden on mobile)

自定义显示文字；留空时自动使用状态名称: Custom display text; leave empty to use the state name automatically
选择后派发，detail 为 { state, label }: Dispatched after selection; detail is { state, label }
点击右侧操作按钮时派发: Dispatched when the right action button is clicked
线路编号或别名，如 1 / 13 / xj / cae / sub-s6: Line number or alias, e.g. 1 / 13 / xj / cae / sub-s6

内置地铁线路官方色与优化色，支持一键切换，解决发光屏幕下的色差与对比度问题。: Includes official and screen-optimized metro line palettes with one-click switching to improve color separation and contrast on emissive displays.

圆角、阴影、过渡速度的标准化变量，跨组件保持一致。: Standardized variables for radii, shadows and transition speeds, shared consistently across components.
北京地铁各线路官方标志色与优化色。通过 CSS 变量 --line-color-: Official and screen-optimized colors for Beijing metro lines. Colors are mapped globally through --line-color-X CSS variables and can switch between the standard official palette and the optimized palette. Click a card to copy the variable usage.
罗列出在发光屏幕下经过色差校正与对比度增强优化的 11 个典型线路系统，以解决亮: The following representative line systems use color-difference correction and enhanced contrast for emissive displays, improving readability in light/dark themes and reducing glare or ambiguity where lines overlap:
官方柠檬黄明度极高，在白色背景上几乎不可见，引起强烈的眩光。屏幕色微调降低了明度: The official lemon yellow is extremely bright and nearly disappears on white backgrounds, causing strong glare. The screen color slightly lowers luminance and deepens the tone to improve contrast significantly.
官方粉色偏灰，在发光屏上容易显得暗淡。优化色将色相略微向冷色（洋红）微调，呈现更: The official pink has a gray cast and can look muted on emissive displays. The optimized hue shifts slightly cooler toward magenta for a fuller pink and clearer separation from the related Line 19 and Changping Line colors.
微调明度与绿色彩度，在多线重叠的枢纽站，增强与相邻黄绿色系 9号线 的颜色区分度: Fine-tuning luminance and green saturation improves separation from the adjacent yellow-green Line 9 at complex interchange stations, keeping each route visually distinct.
微调蓝绿色的波长偏向，提高在发光屏幕上的青色质感，增大与4号线（青绿）、10号线: A slight teal hue adjustment improves the cyan appearance on emissive displays and increases separation from Line 4 (blue-green) and Line 10 (sky blue).
官方灰粉在白底上极易“隐形”。优化色调高了饱和度与亮度，既保障了文字易读性，又强: The official gray-pink can nearly disappear on white. The optimized color raises saturation and brightness to preserve readability while separating it from similar pink families such as Line 14 and Changping Line.
官方红与1号线大红过于接近。屏幕色略微降低亮度并融入砖红质感，在视觉上增加了与1: The official red is too close to Line 1. The screen color lowers brightness slightly and adds a brick-red character, separating it from Line 1 red and Line 3 magenta while giving the tram system a distinct identity.
官方粉红明度偏暗。优化色将其提纯提亮，使其在多主题切换时更具通透性，并显著增加了: The official pink is somewhat dark. The optimized color is cleaner and brighter for better clarity across themes, with stronger separation from Lines 14 and 19 and less purple drift.
官方指定市郊铁路统一使用深灰色，多线并行重叠时无法辨认。屏幕色大胆为 S1(红): The official suburban-rail palette uses the same dark gray for every line, making parallel overlaps hard to distinguish. The screen palette assigns distinct colors to S1 (red), S2 (blue), S5 (pink) and S6 (green) for clear visual separation.
